HAVE QUESTIONS?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before choosing wall cladding solutions for residential projects, exterior surfaces, architectural spaces, and commercial applications.

−

What is wall cladding used for?

Wall cladding is used to improve wall aesthetics while adding surface protection, texture, and stronger architectural character to both interior and exterior spaces.

+

Can wall cladding be installed outdoors?

Yes. Wall cladding is widely used for exterior elevations, facades, compound walls, and outdoor surfaces exposed to changing weather conditions.

+

Is natural stone wall cladding durable?

Absolutely. Natural stone wall cladding offers excellent long term durability and maintains its structural strength and surface finish for years.

+

Does wall cladding require frequent maintenance?

No. Quality wall cladding surfaces require very little maintenance and continue to retain their natural appearance over long periods.

+

Do you supply wall cladding across Bangalore?

Yes. Jain Stones & Tiles supplies premium wall cladding solutions across Bangalore for homes, architects, builders, and commercial projects.
